identity.content: Adaptive Evolutionary Dynamics / Adaptive Evolutionary Architecture source lineage; repository identity retained without treating naming variation as separate theory.

content.source_status: early research framework / research program; not completed or validated theory

identity.content: Source citation metadata positions the work across adaptive systems, evolutionary dynamics, complex systems, cybernetics, information theory, AI, dynamical systems, innovation/search theory and self-improvement; citation metadata carries no scientific authority.
Contribution rules require role separation, falsifiability, explicit assumptions/limitations and anti-recursion; governance is preserved as governance, not scientific result.

source_described_scope_or_purpose.content: Study when adaptive systems move from improving within fixed reachable spaces to modifying the mechanisms that determine reachable possibilities.
Empirical program aims to operationalize latent generator dynamics, reachable spaces and evolutionary velocity and discriminate them from ordinary resource/capability growth.
Code surfaces provide representation, proxy, causal-analysis and synthetic simulation machinery; they do not constitute execution evidence.

definitions_and_formal_structures.content: Lambda=d/dt log|P_reach| and is decomposed into resource, capability and generator contributions.
Repeated primary formulation: Omega=Delta_G=(partial log|P_reach|/partial G_m)*dot G_m.
state_transition_equations.md formulation: Omega=dG_m/dt; operational proxy may use dLambda/dt.
Source proposes several operational Omega estimators/proxies across measurement and simulation surfaces; no single estimator is validated or unified by compression.
Static causal influence/mass formulations quantify downstream state influence.
Dynamic causal mass has multiple source formulations involving future reachable transformation capacity or generator effects; variants remain source-relative rather than silently unified.

content.evolutionary_primitive: stored transformation that can modify future transformations

definitions_and_formal_structures.content: Do not add an entity where a trajectory variable/derivative explains the phenomenon; meta is treated as a dynamic property.

assertions_or_hypotheses_and_interpretat.content: Major capability transitions are proposed to be preceded by changes in capability-generation mechanisms: Delta G_m -> Delta Omega -> Delta C.
Capability, capability growth, resources and evolutionary acceleration are distinct; C growth alone is insufficient evidence of Omega.
Reachable futures are operationally distinct from abstract possible futures and depend on representation, search/generator mechanisms and resources.
Deeper adaptive targets are proposed to change future transformation dynamics; D2->D3 is treated as critical transition toward accelerating capability-generation dynamics.
Updated state-transition formulation proposes sustained acceleration requires G->A->X->P->C propagation; generator improvement alone is insufficient.
Twenty explicit framework assumptions are preserved as assumptions rather than converted into supported claims; measurability-in-principle and temporal ordering remain assumed/testable.

Framework source relates its constructs to evolution, cybernetics, complex systems, information theory, AI/search, innovation economics, cognition and philosophy of science; these are interpretive connections, not dependencies or validations.
Automatic differentiation is interpreted as reusable transformation/generator-capacity transition and historical hypothesis for testing.
Compilers are interpreted as reusable transformation generators and adaptive-depth transition; no historical validation is inferred.
Machine learning is interpreted as representation/search/generator transition with possible future D3 regime; current D3 standing is not established.
Scientific method/institutions are interpreted as evolutionary primitives/generator infrastructure; source-level historical claim is preserved without empirical promotion.
Repository explicitly states historical examples are hypotheses for testing, not confirmed demonstrations.

methodology_or_test_protocol.content: Framework is weakened/falsified by capability transitions without prior generator change, generator change without acceleration, resource-only explanations, failed temporal ordering or nonpredictive Omega/proxies.
Proposed matched controls, difference-in-differences, event studies, instrumental variables, Granger tests and mediation analyses isolate generator effects.

Candidate G_m proxies include iteration-cost reduction, search-space expansion, reusable infrastructure, improvement automation, representation compression, search efficiency and self-modification capacity; no single proxy sufficient.

Candidate Omega estimators include improvement efficiency, generator reuse, iteration compression, search expansion, representation compression and weighted composites; weights require empirical determination.

Candidate P_reach estimators cover breadth, diversity, frontier distance, search efficiency, representation compression, transferability, combinatorial expansion, horizon and constraint reduction; no single proxy sufficient.
Phase Boundary Dataset is a proposed schema and candidate-case program, not a populated empirical dataset.
Experiment program proposes historical, organizational, AI and benchmark tests with resource/capability/generator controls; source template is internally incomplete.

source_described_status.content: Source says empirical program is incomplete until latent variables become measurable and validated.
state_transition_equations.md self-labels as canonical dynamical system; this has no automatic supersession effect.
CITATION.cff repository-code literally contains YOUR_USERNAME placeholder; retained without correction.

limitations_or_open_questions.content: G_m, P_reach and Omega are latent/indirectly observable; proxy validity remains open.
experiments/README.md terminates after introducing an experiment template and does not provide the template fields.
execution_barrier_phase_boundary.py exists but contains one newline only; no experiment, failure or negative result is inferred.
Can capability-generation acceleration be measured before visible capability explosion, and can generator effects be distinguished from resources/current capability?

Implements finite-set reachability proxy objects, expansion/distance/search/generator operations and direct-run example.

Synthetic simulations instantiate baseline/resource/generator/adoption/barrier/frontier/long-horizon/constraint scenarios with multiple incompatible file-local Omega proxies; they are model implementations, not observed experiments.
